goodResponse.question: Why did Jesus weep?
goodResponse.answer: ✦ Jesus wept in John 11:35 because He felt genuine compassion for Mary and others mourning Lazarus' death. Even knowing He would raise Lazarus, Jesus showed His full humanity. "Jesus wept" (John 11:35) reminds us that God understands our grief deeply.
